integrity: The six-edge example and each smaller-size exclusion are derived using exact integer arithmetic and a self-contained finite enumeration; no independent scientific audit or external certification has been conducted.
scientific_limitations: Finite exact enumeration of connected graphs through five vertices only. Each graph is fully occupied by two types with at least two agents of each type; utility is the untruncated fraction of like-colored neighbors. Strict improvement belongs to the two moving agents, whereas half-satisfaction is an external social headcount. No global convergence, larger graph classification, or independent bibliographic uniqueness is claimed.
title: Five vertices are sharp for satisfaction loss under profitable Schelling swaps
